observations: Front cover of a PS4 game case for Gran Turismo 7.
The case is wrapped in clear plastic, suggesting it is new or re-wrapped.
PEGI 3 rating is visible on the bottom left.
PlayStation Studios and Polyphony Digital logos are present.
A watermark 'OG GADGETS STORE' is overlaid on the image.
The background shows several other PS4 game cases on a shelf.

risks.risk: The disc may be missing, scratched, or a different game if the shrink-wrap is not factory original.
risks.proof: A video of the case being unwrapped and the disc being shown.
risks.if_unproven: as a used disc in average condition

risks.risk: Region mismatch for DLC; PEGI 3 indicates a European/Middle Eastern release which may not match a Nigerian PSN account for add-on content.
risks.proof: Photo of the back of the case showing the region globe icon.

proof_requests: Photo of the back of the case.
Photo of the disc surface if the seller is willing to unwrap it.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as Gran Turismo 7 for PS4. While it appears sealed, it is priced as a used copy to account for the risk of re-wrapping or internal damage.
